$comment: Boundary fixtures for PPh Badan + facilities migration (Task 7). Every expectation encodes a verified primary-source fact. UU 36/2008 Art 17(1)(b): 25% from Tax Year 2010 (still 25% in 2019); listed-company reduction 5pp -> 20%. Perppu 1/2020 -> UU 2/2020 Art 5(1)(a): 22% for Tax Years 2020-2021; listed -> 19%. UU 7/2021 HPP Art 3 point 7 amending UU PPh Art 17(1)(b): 22% from Tax Year 2022-current; listed reduction now 3pp -> 19%. UU PPh Art 17(2b) + PP 55/2022 Art 64-65 + PMK 40/2023: listed conditions (>=40% traded, >=300 parties, each <5%, >=183 days/year, reporting); reduction is 3 PERCENTAGE POINTS, not 3% proportional. UU PPh Pasal 31E(1): resident badan with gross turnover <= Rp50bn gets 50% rate reduction on PKP attributable to first Rp4.8bn turnover. Formula turnover <= Rp4.8bn: 50%x22%xPKP. Formula Rp4.8bn<turnover<=Rp50bn: proportional allocation. Mandatory when eligible, not elective. No reduction above Rp50bn. IKN facilities PMK 28/2024 Art 4(1) 100% reduction; Art 8/10 duration schedules; Art 8(5) 50% for 'other business' 2031-2045. Mark needs_review when category/eligibility not fully evidenced. Rates stored as decimal fractions (0.22 = 22%). Amounts are 2-decimal currency strings in IDR. Tax-year semantics: a Tax Year N is covered by an interval whose validFrom is YYYY-01-01 of the year the rate first applies. See data/v2/sources.json for primary locators.

effectiveDate.$comment: Corporate rate chronology (tax-year based). UU 36/2008 brought the 25%/28% badan tier structure into 28% pre-2010 then 25% from Tax Year 2010; this fixture focuses on 2010-current as the brief specifies. UU 2/2020 (Perppu 1/2020) 22% applies to Tax Years 2020 and 2021. UU 7/2021 HPP 22% applies to Tax Year 2022 onward. The scheduled 20% from 2022 under UU 2/2020 was SUPERSEDED by UU HPP keeping 22%.

concepts.$comment: Distinct concepts: base corporate rate, listed-company reduction, Article 31E small-business facility, IKN facility. Facilities are conditions/formulas, not standalone unconditional rates.

boundaries.description: UU 36/2008 Art 17(1)(b): 25% corporate rate still in effect for Tax Year 2019. Boundary day 2019-06-15 must resolve 25%, NOT 22%.
Perppu 1/2020 -> UU 2/2020 Art 5(1)(a): 22% for Tax Year 2020. Boundary day 2020-06-15 must resolve 22%, NOT 25%.
UU 2/2020 Art 5(1)(a): 22% still in effect for Tax Year 2021 (the last year of the UU 2/2020 regime).

UU 7/2021 HPP Art 3 point 7 amending UU PPh Art 17(1)(b): 22% from Tax Year 2022 onward. The scheduled 20% from 2022 under UU 2/2020 was SUPERSEDED by UU HPP keeping 22%. Boundary day 2022-06-15 must resolve 22%, NOT 20%.
UU HPP 22% continues through Tax Year 2025 (current).
UU 36/2008 Art 17(1)(b) jo. listed conditions: a qualifying listed company gets a 5 percentage point reduction 25% -> 20% for Tax Year 2019. Reduction is in PERCENTAGE POINTS, not 3% proportional.
UU 2/2020 Art 5(1)(a): qualifying listed company gets 22% - 3pp = 19% for Tax Years 2020-2021.

UU 7/2021 HPP Art 3 point 7 amending UU PPh Art 17(1)(b) + Art 17(2b): qualifying listed company gets 22% - 3pp = 19% from Tax Year 2022-current. Reduction is 3 PERCENTAGE POINTS, not 3% proportional (which would be 21.34%).

Listed-company reduction requires all conditions (>=40% traded, >=300 parties, each <5%, >=183 days/year, reporting) AND the derived gate fact listedConditionsMet. Without the float/ownership facts, resolver must return fakta_kurang or bersyarat — never an unconditional 19%.

When listed conditions are NOT met (e.g. floatTradedPct below 40%, so listedConditionsMet=false), the listed reduction does not apply. Resolver must NOT return 19%; the base 22% (via concept-pph-badan-base) applies instead.

UU PPh Pasal 31E(1): resident badan with gross turnover <= Rp4.8bn gets 50% rate reduction on PKP attributable to first Rp4.8bn turnover. Formula when turnover <= Rp4.8bn: 50% x 22% x PKP. For PKP 1.000.000.000 and turnover 4.000.000.000: PPh = 50% x 22% x 1.000.000.000 = 110.000.000.
At turnover exactly Rp4.8bn, the full PKP is attributable to the first Rp4.8bn, so the full 50% reduction applies: 50% x 22% x PKP.

UU PPh Pasal 31E(1): when Rp4.8bn < turnover <= Rp50bn, only the PKP PROPORTIONALLY attributable to the first Rp4.8bn turnover gets the 50% reduction (proportional allocation, NOT whole-PKP flattening). For turnover 24.000.000.000 (5x the 4.8bn threshold), 1/5 of PKP 1.000.000.000 = 200.000.000 gets 11% (22% x 50%), the rest 800.000.000 gets 22%. PPh = 22.000.000 + 176.000.000 = 198.000.000. Effective rate = 19.8%.
At turnover exactly Rp50bn, the badan is still eligible for Article 31E (boundary is inclusive at 50bn).

UU PPh Pasal 31E(1): no reduction above Rp50bn turnover. A badan with turnover 60.000.000.000 is NOT eligible (article31eEligible=false); the base 22% applies. The 31E concept must NOT resolve to a reduced rate.
Article 31E eligibility depends on the grossTurnover fact. Without it, resolver must return fakta_kurang — never an unconditional 11%.

PMK 28/2024 Art 4(1): IKN business in an eligible category gets 100% reduction for the duration per Art 8/10 schedules. The full category/eligibility/investment-window facts are not always available, so the record must surface as needs_review (bersyarat), never as an unconditional 0% tepat.
Without the IKN business category and investment window facts, the IKN facility cannot resolve exactly. Must return fakta_kurang or bersyarat — never an unconditional 0% tepat.

article31e.$comment: Article 31E proportional allocation parameters. Base rate 22% (UU HPP). Reduction 50% on the PKP proportionally attributable to the first Rp4.8bn turnover. Turnover ceiling Rp50bn for eligibility (inclusive). Formula not whole-PKP flattening.

listedReduction.$comment: Listed-company reduction is in PERCENTAGE POINTS, not proportional. Pre-2020: 5pp off 25% = 20%. 2020-2021 (UU 2/2020): 3pp off 22% = 19%. 2022-current (UU HPP): 3pp off 22% = 19%. Conditions: >=40% floated, >=300 shareholders, each <5%, held >=183 days/year, reporting compliance.
